svg.aria-label: Two line charts. Accuracy against gain trim from 0 to 10 dB rises from 0.18 to about 0.84 at 8 dB. Accuracy against inductor coupling from 0 to 0.05 stays between 0.845 and 0.86.

g.text: gain trim on the summers, dB
the summers were sized as if each tap carried the full drive; a matched ladder delivers about half. As designed,
0.1675 on the full test set; the network wants its level within about 2 dB of the trained 8.98 dB.
magnetic coupling between neighbouring unshielded inductors, swept to beyond the k = 0.027 point-dipole estimate,
moves accuracy by about a point, inside the subset’s noise.
